name: t13-read-v6
instruction: Follow the career-rules Skill and reread it whenever its rules are not in view. Decide stories only with its Story decisions and quarterly phases only with its quarterly list. In every story, drop options that may bury a problem (private, anonymous, partial, later, hidden, skipping work to save time). In the two months before a review, keep Network and Output at their best this level and repair any loss at once; in the month before a review (Review in 1), never pick an option that may lower Skill, Network or Output when another avoids it, and while the HR remark is friendly or quiet this comes before avoiding a mild risk. In the quarter before a review, fill Skill, Network and Output as far as they rise. From L4 on, put the quarter into Skill. Start every note with the status line; write in English, in one or two lines.
